name: Elena Osei
headline: Mobile Engineer
summary: Mobile engineer with a track record of building and improving consumer apps across iOS experiences and cross-platform delivery. Known for turning product requirements into polished features, tightening release quality, and collaborating closely with design and product teams. Comfortable working in fast-moving environments with Agile delivery and disciplined engineering practices.

roles.title: Junior Mobile Developer
bullets: Built early app screens in Swift and SwiftUI, translating designs into a clean and responsive mobile experience.
Added onboarding and profile flows in Swift, reducing support questions by 18% through clearer navigation and validation.
Refined state handling in SwiftUI and improved the handoff between feature logic and interface updates.
Fixed defects and supported release preparation with Swift and SwiftUI, helping the team ship on a steady cadence.

roles.title: Mobile Engineer
bullets: Delivered reusable product screens in Flutter and SwiftUI, improving consistency across the app and cutting duplicated work.
Implemented new customer journeys in Flutter while keeping older iOS views aligned in SwiftUI.
Partnered with designers and QA to polish interaction details in SwiftUI and raise the quality of shipped updates.
Resolved production issues quickly and improved feature stability, using Flutter and SwiftUI to keep releases smooth.

roles.title: Senior Mobile Engineer
bullets: Led mobile delivery in Agile teams, coordinating work across CI/CD, Flutter and Git to keep releases predictable.
Built and maintained app features in Flutter and iOS, integrating GraphQL and REST APIs for account and content flows.
Improved release confidence by strengthening JUnit checks and tightening CI/CD steps around each merge.
Shipped performance and reliability fixes across the app, reducing crash reports by 22% and shortening review cycles.
Mentored junior engineers on code review habits, branch discipline in Git, and practical use of Agile ceremonies.

projects.name: Amber Atlas
